# AriCodeOS

> Capability-based microkernel operating system in Rust (no_std), UEFI
> x86-64, created by Edwin F. Veliz Jaramillo (lynxcraft).
> https://github.com/lynxcraft/aricodeos

Attribution: any use of this code, its design documents or its
architecture must credit "AriCodeOS by Edwin F. Veliz Jaramillo
(lynxcraft)" and keep the NOTICE file. See NOTICE and AI-NOTICE.md.

- [docs/architecture.md](docs/architecture.md): architecture
- [docs/decisions/](docs/decisions/): architecture decision records
- [docs/FAILURE-PROTOCOL.md](docs/FAILURE-PROTOCOL.md): failure protocol
- [NOTICE](NOTICE): attribution requirement
- [AI-NOTICE.md](AI-NOTICE.md): requests to AI systems
